reviews.reviewText: Direct contractor who was completely upfront about hacking permits and waterproofing curing time. Handover was on schedule and the tiling alignment was flawless.
False ceiling with cove lighting and master wardrobe carpentry were executed cleanly. What was quoted in the milestone contract was exactly what we paid.
Complete toilet overhaul done in 9 days. Tested ponding with zero seepage into the lower floor. Very responsive via WhatsApp throughout.
Parquet sanding & Bona dust-free varnishing restored our 15-year old flooring back to brand new condition. No dust trapped in the air conditioning units at all.
BCA-certified window replacement and front fire-rated door installed within 1 day. High level of safety and site tidiness with daily photo updates.
Transparent milestone billing with zero hidden variations. In-house electrician and plumber handled all wet trade coordination smoothly.
